doc: §35 CHANGE IMPACT DECLARATION schema. Before a material change, write architecture/change_impact.json matching this shape; the checkpoint's CHANGE_IMPACT_MATCHES_OBSERVED check (§36) then verifies the actual DAG matches the declaration (e.g. a declared-removed edge must be absent from system_dag.json), flagging ARCHITECTURE_DRIFT otherwise.
